title: Release-candidate rehearsal, staged pilots and ecosystem rehearsal — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Static rehearsal contracts, reproducible packaging validation, staged pilot deployment protocols, non-negotiable PRISMA-S / human screening authority bounds, and registry submission blockers across 9 ecosystem targets verified; live release candidate compilation, cross-platform matrix testing, field pilot deployments, and external registry publications remain open operational gates.

synthesized_findings: The multidisciplinary expert evaluation panel reached unanimous consensus approving Track 36 (Release-candidate rehearsal, staged pilots and ecosystem rehearsal). The core release rehearsal, staged pilot protocol, packaging reproducibility, and ecosystem registry assets—including release/rehearsal.json, scripts/check_release_rehearsal.py, .github/workflows/release-candidate.yml, docs/releases/release-candidate.md, docs/pilots/pilot-protocol.md, registry/status.json, scripts/package_source.py, scripts/check_packaging_reproducibility.py, and tests/test_release_candidate_pilots_governance.py—demonstrate exceptional operational discipline, verifiable boundary enforcement, and uncompromising methodological rigor. Clean-room release candidate requirements in release/rehearsal.json enforce 11 mandatory gating checks across compilation, testing, fuzzing, provider receipts, canaries, and rollback, with automatic release and registry submission disabled fail-closed. Deterministic source packaging verified via scripts/check_packaging_reproducibility.py ensures bit-for-bit reproducible source archives and manifests without VCS leakage. The pilot deployment protocol in docs/pilots/pilot-protocol.md establishes a three-stage hierarchy (local_researcher, institution_self_hosted, remote_single_tenant) with strict methodological safeguards: PRISMA-S is maintained as a reporting contract rather than a conduct standard, autonomous study exclusion by non-human agents is categorically barred, and restricted full-text, credentials, and personal data remain deployment-controlled. In registry/status.json, all 9 ecosystem targets (github, crates.io, GHCR, official-mcp-registry, glama, smithery, github-releases, zenodo-osf, joss) are locked to prepared_not_submitted with null evidence URLs and explicit technical and governance blockers. All 6 unit tests in tests/test_release_candidate_pilots_governance.py pass network-free. The three higher-evidence operational gates remain preserved as open in the evidence ledger.

Rollback requirements, automatic registry submission prohibition, and exhaustive explicit blockers across all 9 submission targets in registry/status.json verified.
